Name: RT-TXANT-01 Target Angle vs PTU Angle changes x-axis in output slides
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open; default settings applied.
Objective: Verify that switching between Target Angle and PTU Angle produces diagrams with the correct angle source on the x-axis.
Test Script (Step): Select 'Target Angle' radio button in the Input Setup group. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes without error. Generated PPTX diagram slides use target angle on the x-axis.

Test Script (Step): Select 'PTU Angle' radio button. Click Start again.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes. Diagram slides use PTU angle on the x-axis. The numeric range on the x-axis differs from the Target Angle run. No crash.

Name: RT-TXANT-02 Upside-Down sensor orientation inverts angle data
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that Upside-Down orientation inverts the angle values compared to Normal orientation.
Test Script (Step): Set Sensor Orientation to Normal. Click Start. Note the x-axis angle values on the first diagram slide.
Test Script (Expected Result): Diagrams generated with normal angle orientation.

Test Script (Step): Set Sensor Orientation to Upside-Down. Click Start. Compare x-axis angle values.
Test Script (Expected Result): Angle values are inverted (mirrored) relative to the Normal run. Both runs complete without crash.

Name: RT-TXANT-03 Elevation-only mode produces no azimuth slides
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data with both azimuth and elevation measurements loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that unchecking Azimuth Diagrams and keeping Elevation Diagrams produces only elevation slides.
Test Script (Step): Uncheck Azimuth Diagrams. Ensure Elevation Diagrams is checked. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes without errors.

Test Script (Step): Open the generated TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx. Inspect slide titles.
Test Script (Expected Result): No azimuth diagram slides are present. Only elevation diagram slides appear after the header slides.

Name: RT-TXANT-04 Both checkboxes unchecked generates only header slides and log warning
Objective: Verify that unchecking both Azimuth and Elevation Diagrams logs an error and produces a PPTX with only header slides.
Test Script (Step): Uncheck both Azimuth Diagrams and Elevation Diagrams. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes without application crash.

Test Script (Step): Inspect the log panel for warning or error messages.
Test Script (Expected Result): Log contains an error or warning indicating no diagram type is selected.

Test Script (Step): Open TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains only the Warnings/Errors and Separation Sheet slides. No diagram slides are present.

Name: RT-TXANT-05 X-Scale Autoscale overrides manual values
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; X-Scale Autoscale unchecked; X-Scale Azimuth=45, X-Scale Elevation=20.
Objective: Verify that enabling X-Scale Autoscale causes the axis range to be derived from data, not the manual fields.
Test Script (Step): Set X-Scale Azimuth to 45 and X-Scale Elevation to 20. Uncheck Autoscale. Click Start. Note x-axis range in PPTX.
Test Script (Expected Result): Diagrams use ±45° azimuth and ±20° elevation.

Test Script (Step): Check X-Scale Autoscale. Click Start again. Compare x-axis range.
Test Script (Expected Result): X-axis range is determined from actual data. The ±45°/±20° manual values are not applied. No crash.

Name: RT-TXANT-06 Manual X-Scale rejects values above 150
Precondition: Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open. X-Scale Autoscale is unchecked.
Objective: Verify that the X-Scale fields reject out-of-range integer values.
Test Script (Step): Enter 200 in the X-Scale Azimuth field.
Test Script (Expected Result): Field rejects the value or clamps to the maximum of 150. Value above 150 is not accepted.

Test Script (Step): Enter a non-integer value such as 'abc' in X-Scale Elevation.
Test Script (Expected Result): Field rejects the non-integer input. Previous valid value is retained.

Name: RT-TXANT-07 Graphs per Slide = 1 produces one graph per diagram slide
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data with multiple sensors loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that setting Graphs per Slide to 1 places exactly one graph on each diagram slide.
Test Script (Step): Set Graphs per Slide to 1. Click Start. Open the generated PPTX.
Test Script (Expected Result): Each diagram slide contains exactly one graph image. No slide has more than one graph.

Name: RT-TXANT-08 Graphs per Slide = 4 produces four graphs per diagram slide
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data with multiple sensors loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that setting Graphs per Slide to 4 places four graphs on each diagram slide.
Test Script (Step): Set Graphs per Slide to 4. Click Start. Open the generated PPTX.
Test Script (Expected Result): Each full diagram slide contains four graph images. Incomplete last slide may have fewer. No crash.

Name: RT-TXANT-09 Invalid Graphs per Slide value logs error and produces header-only PPTX
Objective: Verify that entering 0 for Graphs per Slide is handled gracefully with a log error.
Test Script (Step): Set Graphs per Slide to 0 (if field permits). Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Log contains 'Invalid graphPerSlide configuration' error. PPTX contains only header/warning slides. No crash.

Name: RT-TXANT-10 Plot Original Only excludes normalised slides
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that disabling Plot Normalised Graphs removes normalised slides from the output PPTX.
Test Script (Step): Ensure Plot Original Graphs is checked. Uncheck Plot Normalised Graphs. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes without errors.

Test Script (Step): Open TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx and inspect slide titles.
Test Script (Expected Result): No slide titles contain 'Norm.' or 'Normalised'. Only original graph slides are present after the header slides.

Name: RT-TXANT-11 Plot Normalised Only excludes original slides
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open.
Objective: Verify that disabling Plot Original Graphs removes original (non-normalised) slides from the output PPTX.
Test Script (Step): Uncheck Plot Original Graphs. Ensure Plot Normalised Graphs is checked. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes without errors.

Test Script (Step): Open TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx and inspect slide titles.
Test Script (Expected Result): All diagram slide titles contain 'Norm.' or 'Normalised'. No non-normalised graph slides are present.

Name: RT-TXANT-12 Disabling all Graph Configuration checkboxes logs error
Objective: Verify that unchecking all six Graph Configuration checkboxes logs an error and generates a minimal PPTX.
Test Script (Step): Uncheck all six Graph Configuration checkboxes (Level [dBm], Level Pow. Meter, Level Meas. Spec., Level Meas. Pow. Meter, Frequency [MHz], Time [ms]). Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes. Application does not crash.

Test Script (Step): Inspect the log panel.
Test Script (Expected Result): Log contains 'No graphs configured!' error entry.

Test Script (Step): Open TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains only Warnings/Errors and Separation Sheet slides. No diagram slides are generated.

Name: RT-TXANT-13 Enabling only Frequency graph produces only frequency diagram slides
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; all Graph Configuration checkboxes initially checked.
Objective: Verify that enabling only Frequency [MHz] produces diagram slides for frequency only.
Test Script (Step): Uncheck all Graph Configuration checkboxes except Frequency [MHz]. Click Start. Open PPTX.
Test Script (Expected Result): Only frequency diagram slides are present. No Level or Time slides appear.

Name: RT-TXANT-14 Sensor Slide count limits entries in sensor list table
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data with more than 32 sensor measurements loaded.
Objective: Verify that Num. of Sensors - Sensor Slide limits the number of rows in the sensor list table slide.
Test Script (Step): Set Num. of Sensors - Sensor Slide to 10. Click Start. Open PPTX and inspect the Sensor List table slide.
Test Script (Expected Result): Sensor list table shows at most 10 entries.

Test Script (Step): Set Num. of Sensors - Sensor Slide to 0. Click Start. Inspect the Sensor List table slide.
Test Script (Expected Result): Sensor list table contains zero entries. No crash occurs.

Name: RT-TXANT-15 PPTX slide order is Warnings → Separation → Legend → Sensor List → Diagrams
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data with two or more Tx antennas loaded; default settings applied.
Objective: Verify that the generated PPTX follows the documented slide order.
Test Script (Step): Click Start with two or more Tx antennas in parsed data.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes without errors.

Test Script (Step): Open TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx and inspect the first four slides.
Test Script (Expected Result): Slide 1: Warnings and Errors summary. Slide 2: Separation sheet 'Tx Antenna Diagrams'. Slide 3: Legend. Slide 4: Sensor list table.

Test Script (Step): Inspect diagram slides after slide 4.
Test Script (Expected Result): Slides are grouped by TxAnt index. Each diagram slide title includes the TxAnt index and centre frequency (e.g. 'TxAnt1: CentFreq. = X.XX GHz').

Name: RT-TXANT-16 Running Start twice overwrites previous PPTX without crash
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded; Tx Antenna Diagrams tab open; first Start has already been run and TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx exists in output_tx_diagrams/.
Objective: Verify that running Start a second time overwrites the existing PPTX without error.
Test Script (Step): Note the size and modification time of the existing TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx.
Test Script (Expected Result): File metadata recorded.

Test Script (Step): Click Start again.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes. No overwrite confirmation dialog is required.

Test Script (Step): Inspect output_tx_diagrams/TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx.
Test Script (Expected Result): File modification time is updated. File size is > 0. No crash. No residual lock on the file.

Name: RT-TXANT-17 Sensor Muster filter limits sensors included in output
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data with multiple sensors loaded. Sensor Muster checkbox is enabled on the Parse Protocols tab with at least one muster entry defined.
Objective: Verify that enabling Use Sensor Muster on the Parse Protocols tab restricts the sensors processed in Tx Antenna Diagrams.
Test Script (Step): On Parse Protocols tab, check Use Sensor Muster and define a muster with one sensor identifier.
Test Script (Expected Result): Sensor Muster is active. Only the specified sensor appears in the selected protocols table.

Test Script (Step): Switch to Tx Antenna Diagrams tab and click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes. The PPTX Sensor List table slide shows only the sensor(s) matching the muster. Sensors not in the muster are absent.

Name: RT-TXANT-18 Output directory missing is created automatically before export
Precondition: Valid Tx antenna data loaded. The output_tx_diagrams/ directory has been manually deleted before the test.
Objective: Verify that the tool recreates the output directory automatically when it is missing.
Test Script (Step): Confirm output_tx_diagrams/ does not exist on the filesystem.
Test Script (Expected Result): Directory is absent.

Test Script (Step): Click Start on the Tx Antenna Diagrams tab.
Test Script (Expected Result): Processing completes. No error about missing directory appears in the log.

Test Script (Step): Inspect the filesystem.
Test Script (Expected Result): output_tx_diagrams/ directory has been created. TxAnt_Diagrams.pptx exists inside it with size > 0 bytes.
